summary: Provides the provider integration layer for Pydantic AI, encapsulating model registries, agent creation, prompt building, execution, and mapping between Pydantic AI and standard AI components.
responsibilities: Integrate Pydantic AI functionality including model registries, agent creation, prompt building, and execution.
Map Pydantic AI errors, results, finish reasons, and tools to standard formats.
design_decisions: Integrates Pydantic AI as an external AI provider backend for models, agents, and execution.
